title: Necrotic
html:
For other possible meanings of Necrotic in the game, see:  Necrotic (disambiguation)

⁠Necrotic is one of the damage types in the game.

  • For all sources of Necrotic, see Category:Sources of Necrotic damage.
  • For creatures weak to Necrotic, see Category:Vulnerable to Necrotic.
  • For creatures resistant to Necrotic, see Category:Resistant to Necrotic.
  • For creatures immune to Necrotic, see Category:Immune to Necrotic.

Sources of Necrotic damage

The following sections list various ways in which a player character, or creatures they summon, can deal Necrotic damage.

Special actions, spells, etc. that are exclusively accessible to non-player characters are not listed.

Weapons

The following weapons deal Necrotic damage as part of their regular attacks.

  •  Blackguard's Sword
  •  Crimson Mischief
  •  Dagger of Shar - inaccessible
  •  Duellist's Prerogative
  •  Hollow's Staff
  •  Loviatar's Scourge
  •  Makeshift Bow
  •  Myrkulite Scourge

  •  Shadow Battleaxe - inaccessible
  •  Shar's Sting - inaccessible

  •  Sword of Chaos
  •  Torch of Revocation

Equipment

The following equipment add Necrotic damage to the wearer's attacks or can deal Necrotic damage through other means.

  •  Armour of the Sporekeeper: When dealing necrotic damage, deal +1⁠⁠Necrotic damage.
  •  Dark Justiciar Mail: While obscured, deal 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic to any creature that hits the wearer with a melee attack.
  •  Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Rare): Casting  Shar's Aegis grants  Sharran Retribution which deals 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic to attackers.
  •  Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Very Rare): Gaining  Shield of Faith through any means grants  Sharran Retribution which deals 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic to attackers.
  •  Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon): Weapon attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Necrotic.
  •  Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare): Weapon attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Necrotic.
  •  Flawed Helldusk Gloves: Unarmed attacks deal +1d4⁠⁠Necrotic.
  •  Helldusk Gloves: Unarmed attacks deal +1d6⁠⁠Necrotic.
  •  Horns of the Berserker: Unarmed and weapon attacks deal +2⁠⁠Necrotic unless wearer has full HP.

Consumables

The following consumable items can be used to deal Necrotic damage. In the case of arrows, the damage is in addition to the attacker's regular ranged weapon damage.

  •  Arrow of Ilmater: Deal +1d4⁠⁠Necrotic.

Interactions

  •  Protective Plate: Gain resistance to necrotic.
